name: WF-226 — Milestone Update → Closing Evidence Reconciliation & Recovery Routing

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json;const d=input.deal??input;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const required=Array.isArray(d.required_evidence)?d.required_evidence:[];const verified=Array.isArray(d.verified_evidence)?d.verified_evidence:[];const failed=Array.isArray(d.failed_evidence)?d.failed_evidence:[];const milestones=Array.isArray(d.milestones)?d.milestones:[];const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];const verifiedKeys=new Set(verified.map(x=>String(x.key??x.type??x.name??"").toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean));const missing=required.filter(x=>!verifiedKeys.has(String(x.key??x.type??x.name??"").toLowerCase()));const incomplete=milestones.filter(m=>!["completed","verified","closed"].includes(String(m.status??"").toLowerCase()));let state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Evidence reconciliation cannot proceed.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){reason="Missing transaction identity.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Transaction blockers prevent evidence reconciliation.";}else if(failed.length){state="recovery_required";route="WF-208";reason="One or more required closing evidence items failed validation.";}else if(missing.length){state="evidence_gap";route="WF-208";reason="Required closing evidence is missing.";}else if(incomplete.length){state="incomplete";route="WF-205";reason="Required closing milestones remain incomplete.";}else{state="reconciled";route="WF-207";reason="Required closing evidence and milestones are reconciled.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-226",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,required_evidence:required,verified_evidence:verified,failed_evidence:failed,missing_evidence:missing,incomplete_milestones:incomplete,blockers,state,route,reason,requires_human_review:state!=="reconciled"}}];
